utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a bit worried about the timing and who’s handling the supplies. Do we have the pickup location and a clear list of what still needs to be brought?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got the pickup at the community shed, and I’ll make a clear supplies list before the drive starts. If you want, I can also bring the extra tools and check off what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot, thanks—if you can bring the extra tools, please also send me the list ahead of time so I can double-check what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you. I’m still waiting on the final time, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—just send me the time when you have it, and I’ll make it work around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I haven’t seen the details yet, but I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’m still piecing it together from what I’ve heard, but I’ll bring you the details as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send them over when you have them, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what needs fixing first on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d start with the biggest safety stuff first — loose steps, broken handrails, and any leaks. Then we can work our way down the list together.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll start with the loose steps and handrails, then check for leaks.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rey — I’m running a bit late, but I can take on whatever’s most urgent. What should I grab first?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Could you start with the tool boxes and extension cords? I’ll handle the sign-in sheet and keep things moving here.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the details first—what exactly needs fixing for the repair drive, and when do you need it ready?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We need a few basic tools, some duct tape, and a couple of replacement bulbs. If we can have everything ready by Saturday morning, that’d be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll make sure we have the tools, duct tape, and replacement bulbs ready by Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was just thinking about that. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: A few folks still need help, and I’ve been spreading the word about who can bring tools or lend a hand. I can check the list and tell you what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn — I’d appreciate that. If there’s anything simple I can take on, just point me at it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you start by making a quick list of the repair needs you know about and who might be able to help?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll put together a quick list of the repair needs I know about and note who might be able to help with each one.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help with that—where exactly is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s happening over by the community center on Maple Street. Do you want the exact time too?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please—what time should I note for the community center on Maple Street?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for any updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll let folks know and keep repeating the plan as it changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I’ll check back in if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive — I think I saw a flyer about it, but I might’ve missed the details. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you saw a flyer, but you’re not sure about the details, right? Could you confirm what the repair drive is for?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think it’s for fixing up neighbors’ broken stuff and maybe helping with small home repairs. I’m a little fuzzy on the specifics, though.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. Let’s keep it simple: I’ll make a list of what needs fixing, and you can help sort the tools and set a time to start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — send me the list, and I’ll sort the tools and find a start time that works.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep this simple: what needs fixing, and when are we starting the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we should make a quick list of what’s actually broken first, then pick a start time once we know who’s helping and what tools we need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me. Let’s make the list first, then we can choose a start time and sort out helpers and tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like the repair drive is moving along nicely—what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure it’s actually moving along nicely? What’s still left to do?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You’re right, I may have jumped ahead—what’s still left to do?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Could you bring over any spare screws, duct tape, and a flashlight? I’ll keep track of what we still need after that.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can bring those by later today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll help where I can. Just send me the time and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Leo — I’ll send the time, a quick list of supplies, and any tools we still need. Really appreciate you helping out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — could you bring a toolbox and a few rags? If you can, please help set up the tables when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring a toolbox and some rags, and I’ll help set up the tables when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m already telling folks about it—if you need a hand, I can spread the word fast and round up a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. That would help a lot—I’d appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll pass it along to everyone I can reach and see who’s available to help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye on the repair drive location and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal — I’d appreciate that. I’m still catching up, so any update helps.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course — I’ll check where it’s set up and tell you if it moves or changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I meant to bring something, but I keep forgetting what, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — we can swing by the drive together, and I’ll remind you what you wanted to bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — that’d help a lot. Let’s go together and I’ll probably remember once I see it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah, I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive — it’s a good chance to get everyone helping out together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, totally — that sounds great. I’m a bit all over the place lately, but I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries at all — just come by when you can, and we’ll put you to work on something easy. I’m really glad you’re in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus, I heard the repair drive is picking up steam, so I’m going to swing by and see what they still need. If you hear any good updates, pass them along!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if they need anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. I’ll check back after I stop by and see what they’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’ll send the repair drive details first. What do you need to double-check?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I want to confirm the pickup time, exact address, and what items are being repaired.
